## Summary

Implemented `gateway.NewServer` in `gateway/gateway.go`:
- Builds an `http.ServeMux` with `GET /healthz`, `GET /accounts`, `GET /accounts/{id}`, plus explicit `HEAD` routes returning 405 (a bare `GET` pattern would otherwise silently answer `HEAD` with 200).
- `/accounts` is served pre-sorted by ID, with the optional `active=true|false` filter (exact string match — not `strconv.ParseBool`, which would wrongly accept `"1"`/`"t"`); any other value is a 400 naming the `active` parameter.
- `/accounts/{id}` looks up via a `map[string]Account`, 404 when unknown.
- Since this is an edge server open to raw internet traffic with no proxy, the `http.Server` sets `ReadHeaderTimeout`, `ReadTimeout`, `WriteTimeout`, `IdleTimeout`, and `MaxHeaderBytes` to bound slow/idle clients.
